reasons: Claims to be police or an agency and threatens arrest.
Asks you to act urgently, often over a video call.
Real agencies do not arrest people over video calls.
next_steps: Do not join the call or send any money.
Disconnect and tell a trusted family member.
Call 1930 or report at cybercrime.gov.in.

reasons: Promises guaranteed or doubled returns.
Pushes you to a Telegram or WhatsApp group.
No genuine investment guarantees profit.
next_steps: Do not transfer money or share bank details.
Check the firm on the SEBI website.
If you paid, call 1930 immediately.

reasons: Threatens to block your account or card.
Asks you to click a link to update KYC.
Banks do not ask for KYC through links.
next_steps: Do not click the link or share OTP.
Contact your bank using the number on your card.

reasons: Claims a relative needs urgent money.
Asks you to send money by UPI to a new number.
Scammers copy voices and names of relatives.
next_steps: Call the relative on their usual number first.
Ask a question only they can answer.
Do not send money until verified; call 1930 if you did.

reasons: Says a parcel in your name has illegal items.
Threatens arrest and asks you to call a number.
Customs does not collect money by phone.
next_steps: Do not call back or pay any fee.
Check the courier status on its official app.
Report at 1930 if you shared details.

reasons: Promises easy earnings or an unexpected prize.
Asks you to contact a number or pay a fee.

next_steps: Do not pay any fee or share documents.
Verify the offer on the official website.

reasons: Offers an instant loan with no paperwork.
